bathsMin.description: Only include properties with at least this many bathrooms (decimals allowed, e.g. 1.5). Leave blank for no minimum.
bathsMin.title: Minimum bathrooms

bedsMin.description: Only include properties with at least this many bedrooms. Leave blank for no minimum.
bedsMin.title: Minimum bedrooms

daysOnZillow.description: Only include listings that have been on Zillow within this window.
daysOnZillow.title: Days on Zillow

distressTypes.description: Which distressed listing categories to return. Leave empty for all four.
distressTypes.title: Distress types

homeTypes.description: Limit results to specific property types. Leave empty for all types.
homeTypes.title: Home types

includeAuctionDetails.description: For auction listings whose page links to auction.com, also read that public page for the auction date/time, occupancy, starting bid and lender/attorney details. Adds one request per linked auction and requires "Include full property details".
includeAuctionDetails.title: Include auction details (auction.com)

includeDetails.description: Open each listing's detail page for the listing agent, photos, description, year built and distress flags. Adds one request per listing; rows still return without it.
includeDetails.title: Include full property details

locations.description: US locations to search, one per line: a city ("Austin, TX"), ZIP code ("78701"), neighborhood ("Hyde Park, Austin, TX") or county ("Travis County, TX").
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to return across all locations and URLs (1–5000).
maxItems.title: Max items

priceMax.description: Upper bound on the listing price. Leave blank for no maximum.
priceMax.title: Maximum price ($)

priceMin.description: Lower bound on the listing price. Leave blank for no minimum.
priceMin.title: Minimum price ($)

sortBy.description: Order in which Zillow returns the listings.
sortBy.title: Sort by

startUrls.description: Zillow search pages to scrape instead of (or in addition to) locations. The distress filter is layered on top of whatever the URL already filters.
startUrls.title: Zillow search URLs
